'''Shuldene''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region. Formerly a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] with abundant [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] life, Shuldene froze solid after undergoing an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] shift. Tourists occasionally visited the planet to amaze at the carcasses of massive [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] creatures poking through the [[Glass/Legends|glassy]] ice surface.

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Shuldene was the namesake of the [[Shuldene system/Legends|Shuldene system]], which was located near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]]-most tip of the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]], within the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Shuldene sat at the nexus of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]: [["The Loop" (hyperlane)|"The Loop,"]] which circled the [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebula]] to link Shuldene with the regional planets [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]] and [[Mijos/Legends|Mijos]],<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> and the [[Cerean Reach/Legends|Cerean Reach]], which led back to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" />

Shuldene was once a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] with abundant [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] life, but an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] shift froze the planet solid. The surface turned [[Glass/Legends|glassy]] smooth, except where the carcasses of<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> massive<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] creatures poked up through the ice.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] expansion into the Greater Javin in the [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] blazed lucrative [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes through the region that paved the way for its economic development. Where Shuldene had once been barricaded among the [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] [[Nebula/Legends|gas clouds]], the chief impediments to regional [[Astrogation/Legends|navigation]], Figg's new hyperlanes through the Kiax Nebula connected Shuldene with the heart of the Greater Javin along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Shuldene was originally grouped as part of the Republic's [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] and later the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], before finally being reorganized into the Yarith [[Sector/Legends|sector]] some generations after Figg's [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> circa [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which is set during the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]] and [[New Republic era]]s ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]; see {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}), states that [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] [[Death/Legends|died]] nearly four [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to its setting, or circa [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].</ref> Tourists sometimes visited Shuldene to see its frozen surface and gaze in awe at the [[Death/Legends|dead]] sea creatures suspended in the ice.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shuldene was created for the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|online]] article "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />
